title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v6.0 — Authorization Recovery, Uncertainty Fence, Multi-Effect Saga, Compensation, and Bounded-Bypass Fairness
problem: v5.9 safely blocked revoked or stale capabilities before dispatch, but an authorization could remain live after revocation, creating a liveness gap. Closing that gap naively creates a worse safety risk: after a dispatch permit has passed the immediate pre-effect validation boundary, a missing receipt does not prove that the effect did not happen. v6.0 therefore separates safe pre-dispatch cancellation from ambiguous post-validation recovery, adds explicit reconciliation, models multi-effect operations as sagas rather than fake atomic transactions, and adds bounded-bypass review fairness so routing optimization cannot starve dissenting faces.

predispatch_case.condition: authorization exists but no dispatch permit has passed immediate pre-effect validation
predispatch_case.action: invalidate all permits, preserve old authorization provenance, release the active effect authorization slot, require explicit recovery authorization

post_validation_uncertain_case.condition: a permit passed immediate pre-effect validation but no authoritative receipt is present
post_validation_uncertain_case.action: block all further dispatch from the canceled permit but keep the world outcome UNDETERMINED

late_receipt_case.condition: an authoritative receipt later arrives for the previously validated uncertain permit
late_receipt_case.action: accept the receipt as settlement evidence even though the permit is permanently invalid for re-dispatch

authoritative_no_effect_case.condition: an external authoritative reconciliation establishes that no original world effect occurred
authoritative_no_effect_case.action: release the stale authorization slot and allow an explicitly linked recovery authorization

contradictory_late_receipt_case.condition: a late receipt appears after NO_EFFECT reconciliation or after a replacement recovery authorization was created
contradictory_late_receipt_case.action: quarantine as a lineage conflict rather than silently accepting both histories

recovery_lineage.rule: Recovery must create a distinct authorization identity linked to the canceled authorization and cancellation record.
recovery_lineage.reason: Reusing the same authorization identity would overwrite provenance and make cancellation/recovery indistinguishable from an unbroken original authorization.

multi_effect_saga_model.claim: Sequential coordination with explicit compensation; distributed atomicity is not claimed.
multi_effect_saga_model.ordering_rule: A later forward step cannot be authorized until prior forward steps are receipt-settled.
multi_effect_saga_model.compensation_rule: Compensation is submitted as a distinct protected effect_key with its own proposal, capability lease, authorization, dispatch permit, validation, and authoritative receipt.
multi_effect_saga_model.history_rule: Settling a compensation effect does not delete or mutate the receipt of the original settled effect; both remain true world events in provenance.
multi_effect_saga_model.irreversible_rule: If an irreversible prior step is already settled when a later step fails, the saga becomes PARTIAL_IRREVERSIBLE_REQUIRES_HOST_DECISION rather than pretending rollback succeeded.

bounded_bypass_fairness.purpose: Prevent learned routing priority from becoming practical censorship through starvation.
bounded_bypass_fairness.mechanism: Each pending review ticket tracks bypass_count. Routing priority may select ordinary waiters, but once bypass_count reaches max_bypass the oldest mandatory ticket must be selected.
bounded_bypass_fairness.guarantee_scope: Under continued queue service, an enqueued ticket cannot be bypassed more than the configured bound before becoming mandatory.
bounded_bypass_fairness.important_limit: This is a scheduler fairness property, not a truth or correctness guarantee.

face_learning_extension.new_micromanagement_lesson: Efficiency optimization is allowed only while a bounded anti-starvation mechanism remains active.
face_learning_extension.constitutional_formula: LEARNED_COMPETENCE -> ROUTING; BOUNDED_FAIRNESS -> ACCESS; NEITHER -> SOVEREIGNTY

verified_attack_and_recovery_cases.attack: Capability is revoked after dispatch permit creation but before immediate pre-effect validation.
Permit passes pre-effect validation; authority is then canceled while provider outcome is unknown.
Authoritative receipt arrives after cancellation of a validated uncertain permit.
Provider query proves no original transaction exists after an uncertain dispatch boundary.
Old receipt appears after no-effect reconciliation and replacement authorization creation.
Reservation settles, payment fails before authorization.
Public irreversible step settles, later notification fails.
A low-routing-priority face waits while repeated high-priority faces keep arriving.

new_open_edges.name: CRASH_PERSISTENCE_OF_CANCELLATION_AND_SAGA_STATE
new_open_edges.risk: In-memory cancellation/saga/fairness state can be lost across process crash unless journaled durably before dispatch decisions.
new_open_edges.next_requirement: append-only durable journal with replay and tamper-evident hashes

new_open_edges.name: MULTI_PROCESS_CONCURRENT_DISPATCH
new_open_edges.risk: Thread-local locks do not prove correctness across multiple processes or hosts competing for the same effect key.
new_open_edges.next_requirement: durable compare-and-swap/lease fencing or server-authoritative transaction coordinator

new_open_edges.name: EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_IDEMPOTENCY_BINDING
new_open_edges.risk: If a provider supports idempotency keys, JANUS should bind effect_key/authorization lineage to that provider primitive and verify receipt semantics explicitly.
new_open_edges.next_requirement: provider adapter contract with idempotency capability declaration and receipt verification

new_open_edges.name: FAIRNESS_UNDER_PRIORITY_AND_RISK_CLASSES
new_open_edges.risk: A fixed max_bypass proves bounded review access in this queue model but does not yet optimize deadlines, risk classes, or cost under overload.
new_open_edges.next_requirement: deadline-aware bounded fairness with adversarial overload tests
